scenario.description: Candidate invocation with configs/faster_rcnn/faster-rcnn_r50_fpn_1x_coco.py and no optional overrides, resolved through its four pinned base configs.

facts.claim: The training entrypoint requires a positional config path; it supplies no default config.

anchors.quote:
def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Train a detector')
    parser.add_argument('config', help='train config file path')
    parser.add_argument('--work-dir', help='the dir to save logs and models')

facts.claim: The selected config inherits the Faster R-CNN R50 FPN model, COCO detection dataset, 1x schedule, and default runtime bases.
The entrypoint loads the selected file through external mmengine Config.fromfile and records the launcher in the resulting config.

anchors.quote:
# load config
    cfg = Config.fromfile(args.config)
    cfg.launcher = args.launcher
    if args.cfg_options is not None:
        cfg.merge_from_dict(args.cfg_options)

facts.claim: With the selected no-override invocation, cfg-options merging is not requested.
Without a CLI or config work_dir, the entrypoint derives ./work_dirs/faster-rcnn_r50_fpn_1x_coco from the config filename.

anchors.quote:
# work_dir is determined in this priority: CLI > segment in file > filename
    if args.work_dir is not None:
        # update configs according to CLI args if args.work_dir is not None
        cfg.work_dir = args.work_dir
    elif cfg.get('work_dir', None) is None:
        # use config filename as default work_dir if cfg.work_dir is None
        cfg.work_dir = osp.join('./work_dirs',
                                osp.splitext(osp.basename(args.config))[0])

facts.claim: The entrypoint uses Runner.from_cfg when runner_type is absent and RUNNERS.build when runner_type is present.

anchors.quote:
# build the runner from config
    if 'runner_type' not in cfg:
        # build the default runner
        runner = Runner.from_cfg(cfg)
    else:
        # build customized runner from the registry
        # if 'runner_type' is set in the cfg
        runner = RUNNERS.build(cfg)

facts.claim: None of the selected config or four bases defines runner_type, so the entrypoint selects Runner.from_cfg.
